title: 第十九章 百兽丹第二十章 蛋之殇
content_zh:
“武道七境是修行起点，亦是修行根本，只有夯实基础才能勇猛精进，否则便好比建高楼，根基不稳必有隐患。为师已替你制定好，接下来修炼计划，你第一个小目标，是收集炼制百兽丹的炼制材料……”
此刻，罗冠站在码头，回想起玄龟的提醒。
百兽丹，是以一百种凶兽精血，秘法炼制而成，是成就最强百夫境的关键。但所谓一百种凶兽精血，并非凑数就能满足条件，而是需要这些凶兽精血中，蕴含某种神秘特质。
玄龟并未细说，但从只言片语中罗冠隐约猜到，应是对凶兽“出身”有要求，祖上厉害的才行！够得上“凶兽”称号的，至少是三阶，对应人族千山境且真实战力更强，凑一百种都很难，更别说还有特殊要求，收集起来无疑难上加难。
但罗冠只是皱下眉头，便恢复平静，世间事大都公平，想要取得别人达不到的成就，便必然要付出更多努力、代价。
“船来了！”随着一声大喝，人头攒动的码头，顿时躁动起来。
罗冠抬头看向河上驶来巨船，它七层高长百余丈，前行时推动河水形成绵绵不绝浪潮。
这是一艘靠山宗的船，不出意外的话，他将在船上呆一个月，便可抵达青阳国帝都。
跟随人流，罗冠出示票据后，顺利登上大船，在第四层找到房间，算中等偏上档次。刚坐下喝了杯茶，敲门声响起，罗冠开门便看到了，笑容灿烂的船上工作人员。
“客人，鄙船竭诚为您提供，最舒适的搭乘体验，您如有需要，只需额外支付一份票价，便可从她们中挑选一人作伴。”他身后，是三名衣衫单薄年轻女子，看到罗冠眼神微亮，面露期待。
可很快，这份期待就变成失望。
“不用了。”罗冠语气淡淡。
“客人若改变主意，可随时通过侍从下单，那么我就不打搅了。”
罗冠关上门，从怀里掏出紫玉聚灵盏，服下一半灵液开始修炼。在意识到，灵液于虚弱状况下，能快速恢复自身状态后，罗冠便有意开始存留，以备不时之需。
很快一上午时间过去，到了船上用餐时间，罗冠推门出去，来到位于第四层的餐厅。一边吃饭，一边听人交谈，试图从中得到一些，关于获取凶兽血的线索。至用餐结束，也没什么收获，罗冠并不失望，擦了擦手起身回房。
快到房间的时，罗冠听到一些动静，下意识皱眉。转过长廊拐点，他看到一个年轻人，带着几名面相凶恶男子，正挨个敲门。
“有没有看到一个女人跑过来？长头发，眉间有块红痣！”
“谁把她交出来，本少重重有赏！”
秦朗咬牙切齿，怒气冲天。
突然，他看到走来的罗冠，“小子，有没有看到眉间有红痣的女人？”

罗冠扫了他一眼，“没有。”
秦朗面露警告，“那女人是贼，她偷了本公子的钱袋，千万别想帮她隐藏，以免惹祸上身！”
罗冠面无表情，“让让，你挡我的路了。”他推开房门，“嘭”的一声关上，可就
在这时，脸色微微一变。
空气中，有一缕极淡的脂粉香气。
罗冠沉声道：“出来！”没有回应，他冷笑一声，作势转身开门。
“等等！”一个女人从屏风后出来，咬着嘴唇，“我躲一会，等他们离开就走，绝不会给你惹麻烦。”
罗冠眼底闪过惊艳，这女人非常漂亮，纤腰一握胸前曲线惊人，长发遮掩不住，眉间那块红痣，但这丝毫没有影响她的美丽，反而多了几分别样的诱惑。尤其她穿一身，跟不久前那三个女人款式相似的清凉长裙，该看不该看的地方，都若隐若现。
“你看什么？还不闭上眼！”女人下意识抱胸，神情恼怒。
罗冠挑眉。
就在这时，粗暴敲门声响起，“小子，把门打开！”
女人脸色一僵，拼命摇头。
“开门！再不开门的话，本少就不客气了！”
罗冠转身拉门，女人“嗖”的一下冲到门后，从怀里掏出匕首，努力做出凶恶表情，对着罗冠一通比划。
秦朗脸色不善，看着门内的罗冠，“小子，有人亲眼看到那女人，跑进了这条走廊，除了你这里以外，其他房间我们都搜过了，她一定藏在这！”
门后的女人面露惊慌，她已被发现了，逃无可逃。
罗冠面无表情，淡淡道：“这是我的房间，你们要找人，去别的地方找。”
女人瞪大眼，嘴巴微张，完全没想到罗冠会帮她。
“小子，英雄救美也要量力而行，给你最后一次机会，马上让开！”秦朗一挥手，几名手下跃跃欲试。
content_en:
"The Seventh Level of Martial Arts is the starting point and the foundation of practice. Only by laying a solid foundation can we advance bravely. Otherwise, it will be like building a high-rise building. If the foundation is unstable, there will be hidden dangers. My teacher has made a plan for you. Your first small goal is to collect the refining materials for refining the Hundred Beast Pill..."
At this moment, Luo Guan stood at the dock, recalling Xuangui's reminder.
The Hundred Beast Pill is made from the essence and blood of one hundred kinds of ferocious beasts and is refined using a secret method. It is the key to achieving the strongest Hundred Man Realm. But the so-called hundred kinds of ferocious beast essences and blood are not enough to meet the conditions, but the essence and blood of these ferocious beasts need to contain certain mysterious qualities.
Black Turtle did not elaborate, but Luo Guan vaguely guessed from the few words that he must have a requirement for the ferocious beast's "origin", and his ancestors must be powerful! Those worthy of the title of "ferocious beast" are at least the third level, corresponding to the human race's Thousand Mountains Realm and with greater real combat power. It is difficult to collect a hundred kinds, let alone the special requirements, which will undoubtedly be even more difficult to collect.
But Luo Guan just frowned and then regained his composure. Most things in the world are fair. If you want to achieve something that others cannot achieve, you must pay more effort and cost.
"The ship is coming!" With a loud shout, the crowded pier suddenly became restless.
Luo Guan raised his head and looked at the huge ship approaching on the river. It was seven stories high and more than a hundred feet long. As it moved forward, it pushed the river water to form a continuous wave.
This is a ship belonging to the Patron Sect. If nothing goes wrong, he will stay on the ship for a month before arriving at the imperial capital of Qingyang Kingdom.
Following the flow of people, Luo Guan successfully boarded the ship after showing his ticket, and found a room on the fourth floor, which was considered to be an upper-middle-class room. As soon as he sat down and drank a cup of tea, there was a knock on the door. Luo Guan opened the door and saw the ship's staff with bright smiles.
"Guest, I wholeheartedly provide you with the most comfortable ride experience. If you need it, you only need to pay an additional fare and you can choose one of them to accompany you." Behind him were three young women in thin clothes. When they saw Luo Guan, their eyes lit up with anticipation.
But soon, this expectation turned into disappointment.
"No need." Luo Guan said calmly.
"If the guest changes his mind, he can place an order through the waiter at any time, then I won't disturb him."
Luo Guan closed the door, took out the purple jade spirit-gathering lamp from his arms, drank half of the spiritual fluid and started practicing. After realizing that spiritual liquid could quickly restore one's own state in a weak state, Luo Guan deliberately began to save it for emergencies.
Soon the morning passed, and when it was time to eat on the ship, Luo Guan opened the door and went to the restaurant on the fourth floor. While eating, I listened to people talking, trying to get some clues about obtaining the blood of ferocious beasts. By the end of the meal, there was nothing gained. Luo Guan was not disappointed, wiped his hands and got up to go back to the room.
When he was approaching the room, Luo Guan heard some noise and frowned subconsciously. Turning the corner of the corridor, he saw a young man and several men with fierce faces knocking on the door one by one.
"Did you see a woman running over? She has long hair and a red mole between her eyebrows!"
"Whoever hands her over will be rewarded heavily by me!"
Qin Lang gritted his teeth and was furious.
Suddenly, he saw Luo Guan walking towards him, "Boy, have you seen a woman with a red mole between her eyebrows?"
Luo Guan glanced at him and said, "No."
Qin Lang warned, "That woman is a thief. She stole my young master's wallet. Don't try to hide it for her, lest you get into trouble!"
Luo Guan had no expression on his face, "Rang Rang, you're blocking my way." He pushed the door open and closed it with a bang.
At this moment, his face changed slightly.
There is a very faint fragrance of powder in the air.
Luo Guan said solemnly: "Come out!" When there was no response, he sneered and turned around to open the door.
"Wait!" A woman came out from behind the screen, biting her lip, "I'll hide for a while and leave when they leave. I will never cause you any trouble."
Luo Guan's eyes flashed with surprise. This woman was very beautiful, with a slender waist and breasts.She has an amazing front curve, which cannot be covered by her long hair, and the red mole between her eyebrows, but this does not affect her beauty at all, but adds a different kind of temptation. In particular, she was wearing a cool long skirt similar to the three women not long ago, and everything that should be seen and shouldn't be seen was looming.
"What are you looking at? Don't close your eyes yet!" The woman subconsciously crossed her chest, looking annoyed.
Luo Guan raised his eyebrows.
At this moment, there was a rough knock on the door, "Boy, open the door!"
The woman's face froze and she shook her head desperately.
"Open the door! If you don't open the door, I will be rude!"
Luo Guan turned around and opened the door. The woman rushed behind the door with a "swish", took out the dagger from her arms, tried her best to make a fierce expression, and gestured at Luo Guan.
Qin Lang looked unkind and looked at Luo Guan inside the door, "Boy, someone saw that woman running into this corridor. We have searched all the rooms except yours. She must be hiding here!"
The woman behind the door looked panicked. She had been discovered and there was no way to escape.
Luo Guan had no expression on his face and said calmly: "This is my room. If you want to find someone, look elsewhere."
The woman's eyes widened and her mouth opened slightly. She didn't expect Luo Guan to help her.
"Boy, a hero must do his best to save a beauty. I'll give you one last chance. Get out of the way immediately!" Qin Lang waved his hand, and several of his men were eager to try.
